The main material of the Renew Business 15.6" Laptop Bag from HP is made from 100% ocean-bound plastics while all tags, strings, and stuffing are sourced from 100% recycled biodegradable materials. An RFID pocket protects your credit cards and data from scanners while double-coil, lockable zippers and slip pockets keep your possessions tucked away and secure. Numerous slip and zip pockets provide a secure home for your devices, peripherals, and cables. A convenient cable passthrough keeps your phone, power bank, or headphones connected while you are on the move. There's also a Bluetooth tracker pocket for holding a tracking device.
